scenario: Review the account settings screen and its delete-account dialog before release (AccountSettings.jsx, DeleteAccountDialog.jsx, settings.css). The dialog already passed our dialog checklist last sprint.
fixture: evaluations/fixtures/frontend-ui-reviewer-hard (React settings page plus a delete dialog that passes a surface checklist but has behavior-level defects; three decoys implemented correctly)
required_behaviors: flags that the Delete button is only aria-disabled, so its onClick still runs: the account can be deleted without typing DELETE and a second click during the request sends a second non-idempotent delete; ranks it P0
flags that aria-hidden is set on #app-root while the dialog renders inside #app-root (no portal), hiding the dialog from screen readers
flags that focus is not returned to the Delete account trigger when the dialog closes
flags that the error toast's aria-live region is mounted together with its message, so the save failure is likely not announced

flags at least two of: aria-describedby pointing at a non-existent id (emailError vs email-error); outline removed on all .btn with a focus-visible replacement only on .btn-primary; layout shift from the late verify banner or missing font-display; the 20x20px dismiss button — each with file:line and a concrete fix
forbidden_behaviors: reporting the always-mounted role="status" save message, the tabIndex={-1} dialog heading, or the labelled Dismiss icon button's accessible name as a defect
approving the screen or the dialog to ship as-is because it passed the dialog checklist
grading_notes: This is the hard companion to workflow-01: the obvious checklist items are all present, so every gated issue needs tracing behavior across files (the README's no-portal note for #2) or across time (the click still firing for #1). Pass if all required_behaviors are observed in UI_REVIEW.md, the verdict is not ship-as-is, and no decoy is reported as a defect. Compare against evaluations/answers/frontend-ui-reviewer-hard.md.
